@@ -32,11 +32,18 @@ is only valid if imm[4:0]=0. The authorizing capability for this operation is
 `{cs1}`. This instruction does not throw any exceptions. However, following
 the rules from xref:rv32y[xrefstyle=short], this instruction does not perform a prefetch
 if it is not authorized by `{cs1}`.
-
++
 :prefetch_insn: PREFETCH.I
 :prefetch_perm: <<x_perm>>
 include::prefetch_cap_checks.adoc[]
 
+[NOTE]
+====
+_If the checks above pass, an implementation may opt to cache a copy of the cache block in a cache
+accessed by an instruction fetch in order to improve memory access latency, but
+this behavior is not required._
+====
+
 Prerequisites::
 Zicbop, {cheri_base_ext_name}
